text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up — APAC reseller CloudSpan's PO for the marketplace listing is stuck because legal redlined the indemnity clause. Partner insists on reseller-friendly language. They won't sign until PO reflects reseller alias and indemnity carveouts.
Owen (Deal Desk): Can procurement generate PO without final contract? They keep asking for a PO to trigger marketplace onboarding.
Hannah (Legal): We flagged indemnity expansion — partner added broad third-party indemnities (section 9.3) that we can't accept as-is. We proposed limited indemnity tied to Redwood's negligent acts + standard IP carveouts.
Maya (Partnerships): Partner says their parent company requires the broader language for downstream resellers. They asked if Redwood can accept a purchase-order level note instead of changing the master agreement.
Pri (Finance): Finance won't issue PO unless the contract terms are agreed. We can issue a provisional PO only if Legal signs off. What's the delta exactly?
Hannah (Legal): Delta: partner wants to indemnify downstream customers and Redwood for ANY claim arising from partner-modified hardware/software. We need language that limits indemnity to partner modifications and excludes willful misconduct, and caps liability per PO. Offer: add PO addendum that narrows indemnity to that PO's SKU family and sets a per-PO cap.
Kai (Marketplace Ops): Ops needs the reseller alias in the vendor mapping to route revenue. If reseller alias isn't in the PO metadata, ingestion fails. We can patch mapping manually if deal desk provides alias and PO id.
integrations-bot: Created ticket PRT-6110 (deal-desk) for contract addendum and vendor alias mapping — https://internal.redwood.example/tickets/PRT-6110
Owen (Deal Desk): Proposed plan: 1) Legal drafts PO addendum with limited indemnity + per-PO cap, 2) Partnerships confirm reseller alias and upload signed addendum, 3) Ops map alias to vendor record, 4) Finance issue provisional PO capped to first shipment. Agree?
Maya (Partnerships): I'll get alias from partner: "CloudSpan Resellers APAC" and the authorized signer. Partner can sign addendum today.
Hannah (Legal): Drafting PO addendum now. Target to post to PRT-6110 in ~90m. It will state: indemnity limited to partner modifications, exclude willful misconduct, per-PO cap = USD 50k, jurisdiction = Singapore.
Pri (Finance): If Legal approves addendum, Finance will issue PO-101212 provisional with note: "Provisional — contingent on executed PO addendum; cap $50k; payment hold until ingestion verified."
Kai (Marketplace Ops): Once we have PO id and alias, I'll do a manual vendor mapping and ingest test. Expect mapping change to propagate in ~30 min.
Maya (Partnerships): Partner confirmed signer and will email signed addendum to partnerships@redwood.example after signing. Upload to ticket PRT-6110 when received.
Hannah (Legal): Uploaded addendum to PRT-6110 and recorded approval: "Legal accepts PO addendum with limited indemnity and cap."
integrations-bot: PRT-6110 updated: Legal approval attached.
Kai (Marketplace Ops): Manual alias mapping complete for vendor CloudSpan (alias: CloudSpan Resellers APAC). Ingested PO-101212 test accepted.
Pri (Finance): Converting PO-101212 to active provisional status and notifying partner finance. Payment release pending final ingestion verification.
Owen (Deal Desk): Great — closing actions: PRT-6110 (addendum), PO-101212 issued, alias mapped. Thanks everyone.
Maya (Partnerships): Closing thread. Will reopen if any regressions.
